slides.h: No verdict — but now we know what a verdict looks like
b: Independent-group DESI fit: Ωk = 0.002 ± 0.045 — flat-centred, the window ~1.1σ inside. DR1 pulled open; superseded.
Decision rule: a Collaboration posterior below ~0.02 around zero kills the window; around −0.04 it wins.
